Awards: Dr Chandrashekar Chowdhary Gold Medal (Pedicon 2002) and winner, National Nephrology Quiz 2003. Has a randomised controlled trial on ultrasound-guided femoral dialysis access published in the Clinical Journal of the American Society of Nephrology (CJASN 2010;5(2):235-239). Apollo 24|7 lists his consultation fee at INR 1500.
